summary: Bind retained-run bookkeeping to per-job records so a retention appends facts instead of re-binding aggregate files, and cut retention wall time.

reconciliation.note: Costs measured on #618 and on the build host and hosted runner; see the design note.

scope: Registry evidence, algebra-device bundle sources and the submitted-circuit comparison bind per-job records; the audit check verifies only changed raw archives; the registry check computes each view input once; one command retains a run and a test rejects a retained run without an acquisition.
next_action: Land per-record registry evidence and rebind the two audit claims.

steps.action: research_state.py accepts FILE.json#COLLECTION/FIELD=VALUE evidence; hw-charge-prediction-residuals and hw-ghost-calibration-replay bind their jobs' audit rows
steps.acceptance: research_state.py --check and --self-test pass; an appended audit job leaves both claims byte-identical

steps.action: algebra_device_conjectures.py records and verifies # sources by plan_records.evidence_digest; one successor bundle freezes
steps.acceptance: core-670 passes on the successor and stays green after an appended audit job

steps.action: compare_submitted_circuits.py keeps one immutable row file per job and appends missing jobs; core-281 checks the row directory
steps.acceptance: core-281 passes; --write for one new job adds one file and changes no other

steps.action: reconcile_qpu_inventory.py skips archives whose index digest a verification ledger records; the full tier verifies all
steps.acceptance: audits written with and without the ledger are byte-identical; local check time measured

steps.action: scripts/retain_run.sh chains seed rows, inventory, audit, acquisition stub and views; registry check memoized; a test rejects a retained run without an acquisition
steps.acceptance: one command retains a run end to end; the test fails on a planted unregistered run
